caption:
Here are my spins for the challenge.

I'm now realizing that I put a lot of negative emotions on this ring. Hm.

Well anyways I'm thinking of dropping spooky because I kind of didn't want to do a Halloween challenge this year, but I'm a bit on the fence. Shocking and disappointing are sort of two sides of the same coin, so I have to figure out if I want to really differentiate those. And arrogant has an easy option but I could hold on to it for later and try to think up something more unique.

EDIT: Actually I think I'm dropping shocking and going for spooky. Shocking feels a little too simplistic and similar to other stuff I've done, whereas spooky can be a little more creative. Plus at least then the Halloween people get something.
